title: Borne de hauteur semi-effective pour le problème de Mordell–Lang dans une variété abélienne
author: Jérôme Von Buhren
publication: Journal de Théorie des Nombres de Bordeaux 29 (2017), no.1,307–320
statement_paraphrase: For fixed projective integral family V in A x P, with the specified ample heights and projective embeddings, geometric constants mu>=0 and epsilon>0 exist. Each finite-rank subgroup Gamma has a constant nu>=0 valid for all parameter points p and all a in (V_p minus Z_Vp) intersect C(Gamma,epsilon). The inequality is hat h(a)<=mu h_L(p)+nu. Z_Vp is the union of positive-dimensional abelian translates contained in the fiber. The theorem supplies an explicit geometric mu. The text states no information on nu; the proof chooses an unspecified upper bound nu-prime after excluding unbounded separated sequences.
